data.name: Mawah
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mawah means 'one who is seeking, yearning, longing, or desiring'. It is derived from the root word 'awwah', which signifies a strong desire or craving. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the continuous search for knowledge, spiritual growth, and the love of Allah.
